defs.def: a small flat folding case made of leather or plastic used for keeping paper money and credit cards in （放钞票、信用卡的）钱包，皮夹子

ex.s: When the cashier rang everything up, my dad reached for his wallet and froze.
ex.t: 当收银员把所有东西扫码结算后，我爸爸伸手去拿钱包，却愣住了。

ex.s: Just then I realised that I had zero cash in my wallet.
ex.t: 就在那时，我意识到钱包里一分钱现金都没有。

ex.s: Just then I realised that I had zero cash in my wallet.
ex.t: 就在那时，我意识到钱包里一分钱现金都没有。

ex.s: Focused on balancing the bags, she didn’t notice her wallet falling out of her pocket.
ex.t: 专注于保持袋子平衡，她没注意到钱包从口袋里掉了出来。

ex.s: （30分）I was ready to pay for my bananas at the grocery one night， when fear seized me． My wallet was gone． I could only have left it on the G9 bus， which was now speeding in the dark to some（1）     station．
ex.t: 16．（30分）一天晚上我准备在杂货店付香蕉的钱时，恐惧突然袭来。我的钱包不见了。我只能把它落在了G9公交车上，而那辆车此刻正飞驰在黑暗中驶向某个（1）     站。

ex.s: The（2）     moment was quickly followed by mental math． How much time and money would it cost to replace the（3）     of that little wallet？ The credit cards， the driver's license， the cash， all lost to the bus．
ex.t: （2）____的那一刻紧接着便是心算。更换那个小钱包里的（3）____需要花费多少时间和金钱？信用卡、驾照、现金，全都落在了公交车上。

ex.s: Two hours later， back at my house，I heard a knock on the door． My husband（4）     it while I was on the phone in the dining room． "Does Jennifer live here？" I heard a lady say． In my husband's hand was my wallet， with not a penny（5）     ． She left before I could （6）      make it to the door to offer my thanks．
ex.t: 两小时后，回到家中，我听到敲门声。我丈夫（4）_____应了门，当时我在餐厅打电话。“詹妮弗住这儿吗？”我听到一位女士说。我丈夫手里是我的钱包，一分钱（5）_____都没少。我还没来得及（6）_____走到门口道谢，她就走了。

ex.s: After sharing the story online， I heard from someone，who（7）     the lady as Erin Smith． Without（8）     ，I called to thank her． She said she （9）     my wallet on a bus seat． She （10）     that going to a stranger's house was a（11）      move， but she decided to take the chance． "If I were in that（12）     ． I would want someone to try to find me，"she said．
ex.t: 在网上分享这个故事后，有人联系我，他（7）_____那位女士是艾琳·史密斯。我（8）_____地打电话感谢她。她说她（9）_____我的钱包在公交车座位上。她（10）_____去陌生人家里是个（11）_____的举动，但她决定抓住机会。“如果我处在那种（12）_____。我会希望有人试着找到我，”她说。

ex.s: That’s bad news for the environment — and our wallets — as these outdated devices consume much more energy than the newer ones that do the same things.
ex.t: 对环境来说这是个坏消息——对我们的钱包也是如此——因为这些过时的设备比做同样事情的新设备消耗更多的能源。

ex.s: He then took the wallet to a nearby police station after    22    a note behind to let the owner know it was safe.
ex.t: 然后他把钱包带到附近警局，之前___22___留了张便条让主人知道钱包安全。

ex.s: The policemen told them what Mr Smith did and that the wallet was    24   .
ex.t: 警察告诉他们史密斯先生做了什么，以及钱包被归还了。

ex.s: This guy has nothing and    27    he didn’t take the wallet for himself；he thought about others    28   .
ex.t: 这家伙一无所有，____27____他没把钱包据为己有；他____28____别人。

ex.s: And I never have to carry lots of heavy coins or dirty notes, or worry about losing my wallet–for the fourth time!
ex.t: 而且我永远不用担心携带大量沉重的硬币或脏兮兮的纸币，也不用担心第四次弄丢钱包！

ex.s: It’s my wallet and my mobile phone case.
ex.t: 它既可用作我的钱包，也可用作我的手机壳。

ex.s: This both as my wallet and as my mobile phone case.
ex.t: 它既可用作我的钱包，也可用作我的手机壳。

ex.s: EXAMPLE I can’t find my wallet anywhere.
ex.t: 例 我到处都找不到我的钱包。

ex.s: He takes all the money out of his wallet, counts it and puts it in a saucer.
ex.t: 他把钱从钱包里全部取出，数了数，放进一个茶碟里。
